summary: CytoMed Therapeutics (Nasdaq: GDTC) disclosed receipt of a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice dated October 6, 2026, stating its ordinary shares closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days from August 24 to October 5, 2026, breaching Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The notice has no immediate effect on listing or trading. Nasdaq granted a 180-calendar-day compliance period through April 5, 2027, with a possible additional 180 days if other Capital Market continued-listing standards are met; regaining a $1.00 close for ten straight days cures the deficiency. A reverse stock split is among options. Watch for a split announcement or continued sub-$1 pricing.
